facts.fact: The Stellenbosch University Policy Innovation Lab says its June 2025 catalogue update adds 23 South African AI tools currently deployed across public sector domains, including Cape Town's Smart Safety Technology Suite that analyses CCTV footage.
The Stellenbosch University Policy Innovation Lab says 23 South African AI tools are currently deployed across public sector domains, while calling adoption not widespread and limited in scope.
